newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on Cyprus 91-day t-bills steady at 5.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on Cyprus 91-day t-bills steady at 5.49 pct.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus on Wednesday sold nine million pounds ($17.7 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills with an average yield of 5.498 percent, steady on the yield at the last auction held on June 11, the bank said.
Competitive bids worth 12 million pounds were made for up to 30 million pounds worth of bills on offer, but the bank accepted bids for 9 million pounds.
Yields ranged from 5.502 percent to 5.490 percent, the bank said in a statement. ($=0.508 Cyprus pounds)
